```python
def replace_params(path: str, param_convertors: dict[str, Convertor[typing.
    Any]], path_params: dict[str, str]) ->tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:
    for key, value in path_params.items():
        convertor = param_convertors[key]
        value = convertor.to_string(value)
        path = path.replace("{%s}" % key, value)
    remaining_params = {k: v for k, v in path_params.items() if k not in param_convertors}
    return path, remaining_params
```
